jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About NationsBenefits:**

At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core backoffice functions in the insurance domain.

**About Role:**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Product Manager** to own and drive the strategic direction of our Nations Vision product ecosystem — a multi-tool platform supporting hundreds of clients across the vision benefits landscape. The ideal candidate brings deep analytical rigor, unwavering attention to detail, and a relentless commitment to product quality and accuracy. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can navigate complex, interconnected systems — fee schedules, provider networks, plan configurations, and claims processing — while maintaining the trust of hundreds of clients who depend on flawless execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the Nations Vision platform, balancing client needs, business priorities, and technical constraints

* Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable product specifications.

**Core System Management:**

* **Provider-Facing Claims Portal:** Drive continuous enhancement of the provider portal, delivering new features that improve speed and accuracy for end users

* **Fee Schedule Design & Configuration:** Oversee the accuracy, configuration, and maintainability of fee schedules across the platform; champion self-service configuration tools that empower Operations teams

* **Provider Network Mapping:** Manage the configuration and integrity of provider network data, ensuring accurate mapping across geographies and specialties

* **Plan Access Restrictions:** Direct the setup and validation of plan-level access rules, benefit tiers, and eligibility parameters

* **Claims Processing Engine:** Partner with engineering to optimize claims adjudication logic, troubleshoot processing issues, and ensure accurate, timely claim outcomes.

**Quality & Accuracy Focus**

* Establish and monitor quality benchmarks across all product tools and workflows

* Proactively identify data integrity issues, configuration errors, and process gaps before they impact clients

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce errors, increase automation, and enhance system reliability

* Conduct regular audits and root-cause analyses, implementing preventive measures when issues arise.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary product liaison between engineering, operations, client services, and leadership

* Communicate product updates, risks, and roadmap changes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Partner with client-facing teams to understand pain points and translate feedback into product enhancements

* Collaborate with QA to define testing protocols that ensure system accuracy at scale.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Support hundreds of client configurations, ensuring the platform scales without sacrificing accuracy.

* Address escalations related to fee schedules, network mapping, or claims discrepancies with urgency and precision.

* Gather and prioritize feedback from client-facing teams to inform the product backlog.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare, benefits administration, or insurance technology.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-component systems or platforms.

* Working knowledge of database systems, with ability to write moderately complex SQL queries.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data driven decisions.

* Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in high-stakes, accuracy-critical environments.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for varied audiences.

* Experience with claims processing systems, provider network data, or fee schedule management strongly preferred.

* Proven track record managing products that serve a large, diverse client base.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (MBA a plus).

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead a pioneering FinTech initiative with cutting-edge technologies and scalable architecture.

* Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing, innovative-driven environment.

* Impact the financial ecosystem by building secure, high-performance applications.

* Contribute to cutting-edge products that enhance member engagement in healthcare.

jobs.title: Java - Full Stack Observability Engineer, AVP
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are seeking a hands-on Observability Engineer with strong full-stack software engineering experience and deep expertise in Dynatrace. In this role, full stack means the ability to work across application code, telemetry instrumentation, observability platform configuration, dashboards, alerting, and automation workflows. The ideal candidate will help design, implement, and optimize observability solutions across enterprise SaaS and on-premises environments, enabling proactive monitoring, faster root-cause analysis, and automation-assisted remediation. This position requires excellent communication, analytical, and technical skills, along with the ability to partner effectively with SaaS operations, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams.

  
  

**What you will be doing**

You will own and advance observability enablement for key Charles River services, including implementation standards, telemetry patterns, dashboards, alert quality, and adoption support. Working with SaaS, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams, you will design and implement tooling that improves visibility into service health, performance, availability, and client-impacting issues. This role is critical to strengthening operational readiness and ensuring Charles River products can be monitored, observed, and proactively supported across client environments.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is part of the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market-leading end-to-end investment management platform covering front, middle, and back office capabilities. Charles River IMS supports portfolio management, compliance, order and execution management, post-trade processing, data provisioning and management, performance measurement, and other capabilities central to the investment lifecycle. The Observability Engineer plays a key role in ensuring visibility into the performance, stability, and availability of the platform so teams can identify issues earlier, reduce operational risk, and improve the client experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dynatrace implementation and optimization**

* Implement, configure, and optimize Dynatrace monitoring solutions across SaaS and on-premises environments.
* Build and maintain Dynatrace Dashboards Gen 3 for unified visibility, executive reporting, and operational insights.
* Use Dynatrace SaaS, Grail, DQL, Davis AI, OneAgent, OpenTelemetry, synthetic monitoring, and real user monitoring where appropriate to improve observability coverage.
* Develop reusable implementation patterns and standards that enable consistent telemetry collection across critical services.
  

  

**Monitoring, alerting, and incident insight**

* Define log-based alerts, service-level indicators, trace-log correlation, batch metrics, and alert-quality standards for production services.
* Integrate Dynatrace with external systems, including Azure Event Hub or similar event-publishing platforms, to support downstream workflows and operational reporting.
* Improve root-cause analysis by correlating application, infrastructure, log, trace, metric, and user-experience signals.
  

  

**Performance and reliability engineering**

* Conduct performance impact assessments using custom service detection rules, distributed traces, logs, and service health data.
* Partner with SRE, product, technical support, and engineering teams to ensure observability coverage for critical services and client-facing workflows.
* Support automation-assisted remediation by connecting observability insights to approved automation workflows where appropriate.
  

  

**Training, documentation, and enablement**

* Lead training sessions for SaaS, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams on Dynatrace usage, dashboard interpretation, and observability best practices.
* Develop documentation, onboarding materials, reference implementations, and dashboard templates for observability tools.
* Promote adoption of observability standards across teams by translating technical telemetry into actionable operational guidance.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience designing, developing, implementing, or operating enterprise software systems and applications.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, application performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, telemetry instrumentation, dashboards, alerting, and trend analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Dynatrace SaaS, DQL, Logs on Grail, Dashboards Gen 3, and related Dynatrace capabilities.
* Strong Java or JVM-based engineering experience, including the ability to understand application behavior, instrumentation needs, and production performance characteristics.
* Experience with distributed systems, microservices, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and production support practices.
* Experience with log ingestion, trace correlation, service detection, metrics, and real user monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, SRE, SaaS operations, technical support, product, and client-facing teams to translate observability data into actionable insight.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to both engineering and operational stakeholders.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with React or other frontend frameworks, especially for frontend observability, real user monitoring, and user-experience diagnostics.
* Experience with Azure Event Hub, Power BI, Grafana, Prometheus, or other visualization and telemetry platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and data pipeline observability.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead integrated marketing initiatives across all Cambridge brands, products, and digital properties. The role will be responsible for translating business priorities into cohesive marketing strategies that strengthen brand visibility, generate qualified leads, support product growth, and improve customer engagement.

This strategic and hands-on position covers brand management, digital marketing, content, campaigns, social media, email marketing, events, lead generation, marketing analytics, and go-to-market execution. The Marketing Manager will collaborate with internal business, sales, product, design, content, and technology teams to establish priorities, guide execution, and ensure consistency across all marketing activities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with the company’s business, brand, product, and revenue objectives.
* Create and manage annual and quarterly marketing plans, campaign calendars, budgets, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Lead multi-channel marketing campaigns across websites, email, social media, search, paid media, events, webinars, and other relevant channels.
* Develop go-to-market plans for new products, services, capabilities, and market initiatives, including positioning, messaging, launch plans, and sales-enablement requirements.
* Maintain consistent brand positioning, messaging, tone, and visual standards across all Cambridge brands and customer-facing communications.
* Oversee the planning and development of website content, blogs, social media posts, newsletters, case studies, presentations, videos, sales collateral, and other marketing materials.
* Work closely with sales and business teams to develop campaigns that generate, nurture, and convert qualified leads.
* Guide SEO, email marketing, social media, paid advertising, marketing automation, and website-optimization activities.
* Monitor campaign and website performance using marketing and analytics platforms, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Present regular marketing performance reports covering campaign progress, digital engagement, website performance, lead generation, and key business outcomes.
* Conduct market, audience, competitor, and industry research to identify new opportunities and strengthen marketing strategy.
* Manage marketing projects from planning through completion, ensuring that deliverables meet quality, timeline, budget, and brand requirements.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders, external agencies, technology partners, and vendors involved in marketing execution.
* Establish marketing processes, approval workflows, documentation standards, and quality-control practices.
* Provide direction, feedback, and quality oversight to marketing team members while supporting their professional development.
* Stay current with developments in digital marketing, AI-enabled marketing, customer behavior, marketing technology, and competitive trends.
  

  

Required Qualifications

* 8–12 years of experience in marketing, including significant responsibility for integrated marketing strategy and campaign execution.
* Demonstrated experience managing marketing activities across multiple brands, products, services, or business units.
* Strong understanding of brand management, digital marketing, content marketing, email campaigns, social media, SEO, paid media, lead generation, events, and marketing automation.
* Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technology products, services, or B2B solutions.
* Strong ability to translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans, campaigns, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, timelines, resources, agencies, vendors, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using campaign, website, CRM, and lead-generation data to guide decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, stakeholder-management, and project-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience leading or mentoring marketing professionals and reviewing the quality of marketing deliverables.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  

  

Tools and Platforms

* The successful candidate should have experience with major marketing, analytics, CRM, content, and campaign-management platforms, including several of the following:
* CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesforce Account Engagement, or comparable platforms.
* Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and native social and advertising analytics.
* Email and lead generation: HubSpot, Apollo.io, Mailchimp, or comparable email marketing and sales-engagement platforms.
* Paid and social media: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, and other relevant advertising platforms.
* SEO and competitive intelligence: Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Google Trends, and related research tools.
* Content and website management: Webflow, WordPress, or comparable content-management systems.
* Project management and collaboration: Asana, Jira, monday.com, Trello, Microsoft Teams, or comparable platforms.
* Design and content collaboration: Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Campaign Executive
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Email Marketing & Campaign Manager to plan, manage, and execute email campaigns across all Cambridge brands, products, and target audiences. This contractor will own the complete campaign lifecycle from campaign strategy, audience selection, and scheduling through automation, deployment, optimization, and performance reporting.

The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on campaign management. The selected candidate will work with internal marketing, content, design, product, sales, and technology teams to deliver relevant, timely, and compliant email communications that strengthen engagement, support lead generation, and contribute to business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the email marketing strategy and campaign calendar across all Cambridge brands, products, and business priorities.
* Manage end-to-end execution of newsletters, product promotions, lead-nurturing programs, event campaigns, cold-outreach campaigns, customer communications, and re-engagement campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, segmentation criteria, messaging requirements, schedules, workflows, and calls to action.
* Build, configure, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns using relevant email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
* Create automated workflows, nurture sequences, drip campaigns, lead-scoring logic, triggers, and lifecycle-based communication programs.
* Manage contact segmentation, suppression lists, subscription preferences, consent records, data quality, duplicate records, and campaign eligibility rules.
* Conduct A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, sender names, content, calls to action, layouts, timing, and audience segments.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, identify improvement opportunities, and provide clear recommendations and reports to internal stakeholders.
* Manage email deliverability by monitoring sender reputation, bounce rates, spam complaints, domain authentication, inbox placement, and engagement quality.
* Ensure campaigns comply with applicable email marketing and data privacy requirements, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, consent management, and unsubscribe regulations.
* Maintain campaign documentation, naming conventions, templates, quality-control checklists, approval processes, and reporting standards.
* Stay current with changes in email marketing technology, automation practices, privacy regulations, deliverability standards, and AI-enabled campaign optimization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of hands-on experience in email marketing, campaign management, marketing automation, or a related digital marketing role.
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete lifecycle of B2B email campaigns across multiple brands, products, audiences, or markets.
* Strong knowledge of campaign planning, audience segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, lead nurturing, and customer lifecycle communications.
* Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and optimizing campaigns using leading email marketing and automation platforms.
* Strong understanding of email deliverability, sender reputation, bounce management, spam prevention, domain authentication, and inbox-placement practices.
* Working knowledge of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, subscription management, consent requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
* Experience with A/B testing, campaign analytics, attribution, reporting, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong project management, attention to detail, problem-solving, and internal stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, audience segments, and business priorities simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Tools and Platforms**

The successful candidate should have hands-on experience with leading email marketing, CRM, automation, analytics, and campaign-quality platforms, including several of the following:

* Email marketing and automation: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Account Engagement, Klaviyo, Brevo, or comparable platforms.
* Lead generation and sales engagement: Apollo.io, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms.
* CRM and contact management: HubSpot CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or comparable CRM systems.
* Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, native campaign-reporting tools, and spreadsheet-based reporting.
* Email testing and quality assurance: Litmus, Email on Acid, or comparable email preview and testing tools.
* Deliverability and domain monitoring: Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, MXToolbox, and related reputation-monitoring tools.
* Project and campaign management: Asana, Jira, monday.com, Trello, or comparable project-management platforms.

**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis

* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.

**Job Description: Technical Product Manager**

**Location:** Uppal, Hyderabad

**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Work from Office)

**Experience Level:** Senior (10+ years)

**About US**

**Crowdnetic Technologies Private Limited is a subsidiary of FinMkt.Inc., New York is an unlisted private company incorporated on 18 January 2016 based out of in Hyderabad, Telangana**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Product Manager** to guide how changes are planned and implemented on our backend-heavy fintech platform, built on Java, Spring Boot, Groovy and microservices, with MongoDB and a Vue.js frontend. In this role, you will be the central review point for platform changes, working with engineering, QA and business teams so that each change is well analysed, well designed and documented before development begins.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Use Case Analysis:** Work with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, define use cases and user flows, and confirm expected behaviour before work is taken up.
* **Edge Case Identification:** Identify edge cases, exception scenarios and failure conditions for each change, and make sure they are covered in the design and test plans.
* **Product Design with Technical Analysis:** Translate requirements into product designs supported by technical analysis, covering service placement, API contracts, data model changes and integration points.
* **Change Review & Implementation Approach:** Review change requests, assess their impact across microservices, APIs, MongoDB collections and downstream consumers, and agree on the implementation approach with engineering.
* **Data & Configuration Changes:** Guide changes to MongoDB document structures, indexes and data migrations, as well as Groovy-based scripts and configurations, with attention to backward compatibility.
* **Documentation & Traceability:** Maintain clear records linking requirements, design decisions, code changes and releases, including release and rollback plans for each change.
* **Compliance:** Help ensure product features and technical changes follow applicable financial regulations and standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, SOC2) and support audit needs.
* **Agile Delivery:** Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming and retrospectives, with epics and user stories that include clear acceptance criteria and technical detail.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the technical point of contact between engineering, QA, compliance and business teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Overall Experience:** 10+ years in Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management or Software Engineering, including at least 4–5 years of hands-on backend development or technical leadership in Java and Spring Boot.
* **Industry Experience:** At least 5 years in a fintech organisation (e.g., payments, banking technology, wealth management, lending).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field.
* **Technical Skills:** Good understanding of microservices architecture, including service boundaries, inter-service communication and API contract management; practical experience with MongoDB data modelling, indexing and production data changes; working knowledge of Groovy; familiarity with Vue.js to assess the frontend impact of backend changes.
* **Analytical Skills:** Experience in use case analysis, edge case identification and writing functional and technical specifications.
* **Tools:** Experience with Confluence, Jira and Swagger/Open API, and the ability to read and review code, design documents and API specifications.
* **Communication:** Ability to explain technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience moving teams from legacy systems to modern cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with compliance audits and building features for regulatory reporting.
* Certifications such as CSPO, PMP or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

**Perks and Benefits:**

Work-life balance

Health & accidental insurance

Employee Provident Fund

Open door policy with the leadership team. Co-founders are just a call away.

**Salary:** As Per Industry Standard

**Commute:** Own Transportation (No cab facility)

**Location**: SEZ, NSL Towers, Uppal, Hyderabad – Telangana 500039

Pay: ₹973,084.03 - ₹2,039,968.70 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

jobs.title: Staff AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we are building the most complete AI and Knowledge Platform. By delivering harmonized data, trusted AI, and faster innovation, we uplift and empower our customers—and our customers’ customers—to make better, more confident decisions and actions. The world’s top companies across every major industry trust Teradata to improve business performance, enrich customer experiences, and fully integrate data across the enterprise.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
In this role, you will serve as a Staff Product Manager for Teradata’s AI products driving product vision, strategy, planning, roadmap, execution and adoption. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale platforms.
  
  
Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata Cloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
You will collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, governance and other functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem and would be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor’s in Engineering from a recognized institution. MBA is a plus.
* 8+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 4+ years in product management working with AI/ML or analytics products.
* Good knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including Agents, LLMs, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning and inference pipelines.
* Proven success in embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
* Familiarity with AI tooling and best practices such as for training, inferencing, GPUs, integration and orchestration.
* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise adoption.
* Knowledge of hybrid and public cloud platforms and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Understanding of governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and experience applying them to AI/ML solutions.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders and articulate AI product plans.
* Strong track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.
* Good expertise with user experience, product KPIs and prioritization.
* Experience with AI productivity tools.
* Ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes.
* Ability to mentor product managers and guide them through design, planning, and execution.
* A proactive mindset, comfortable working in fast paced, dynamic environments.
* Adaptability and passion for building impactful AI-driven products.

**What You Will Bring**

* Expertise in building AI products across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
* Exposure to AI model and agent development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at scale.
* Familiarity with GPU and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
* Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
* Ability to operate as a lead guiding product direction and influencing others.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Global HealthX**

Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that

touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins

now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.

**About Healix Engage**

Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare

interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a

roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only

dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.

If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the

meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
* Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
* Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
* Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
* Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
* Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."

**What We're Looking For**

* Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
* A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
* Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course-correct quickly.
* Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
* A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.

Bonus: experience in healthcare, health-tech, or another regulated, high-trust domain.

jobs.description:
**About InvoiceCloud**
InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group. Judges also highlighted our mission to reduce digital exclusion and restore simplicity and dignity to how people pay for essential services, as well as our leadership in AI maturity and responsible innovation. It’s an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud.com.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a customer-focused and technically adept
**Product Manager – Integrations**
to own the roadmap, execution, and continuous enhancement of our integrations platform and ecosystem.
  
  
In this role, you will plan, prioritize, and deliver integration capabilities that enable seamless connectivity between our platform and customers' business-critical applications. Working closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing, you will translate business priorities and customer needs into an executable roadmap and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
This role demands more than execution—it requires a builder's mindset. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, thrives in ambiguity, moves with urgency, and consistently delivers customer value. You should be equally comfortable discussing API architecture with engineers, prioritizing customer needs, and communicating product capabilities to business stakeholders, customers, and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Roadmap & Execution**

* Own the integrations product roadmap, aligning priorities with customer needs, business goals, and technical dependencies.
* Prioritize features, APIs, connectors, and platform enhancements based on customer value, business impact, and engineering effort.
* Collaborate with Product Leadership to translate strategic objectives into actionable roadmaps and release plans.
* Drive the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
* Write high-quality PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Engineering to prioritize and manage the product backlog.
* Coordinate release planning, launch readiness, and post-release reviews.
* Monitor delivery progress, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and communicate status to stakeholders.
* Champion the use of AI and Generative AI to improve product discovery, roadmap prioritization, PRD creation, experimentation, analytics, and decision-making, while identifying opportunities to embed AI-driven capabilities into the integrations platform.

**Product Discovery & Customer Understanding**

* Conduct continuous customer discovery with customers, partners, Sales, Customer Success, and Support.
* Translate customer integration challenges into scalable product capabilities.
* Balance customer-specific requests with reusable platform investments.
* Simplify integration experiences and improve customer onboarding and adoption.

**Ecosystem & Partner Enablement**

* Prioritize integrations with strategic technology partners.
* Collaborate with Partnerships and Engineering to deliver and maintain high-value integrations.
* Support marketplace expansion through new connectors and partner integrations.
* Partner with Product Marketing on go-to-market activities and product launches.

**Product Analytics & Continuous Improvement**
**Define, Monitor, And Improve Key Product Metrics, Including**

* Integration adoption
* API and connector usage

**Description**
The Sr. Product Manager-Tech on the DSP-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end-to-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.
  
  
This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
  
  
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.
  
  
This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
  
  
We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.

The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT DBMCI ONE**

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

**The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.**

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
* Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
* Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
* Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
* Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
* Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
* Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
* Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
* Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
* Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
* Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
* Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
* AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
* Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
* Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
* First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
* High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
* Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

  

Connect directly with HR at **isha.patnaik@dbmi.edu.in** if you believe you are a strong fit.

  

**PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  

**Candidates with hands-on experience building B2C or consumer-facing mobile applications will be given strong preference.**

### Job Summary

TriNet is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive the payroll product area within its HR services platform. This role sits at the intersection of payroll domain expertise and modern product craft - translating complex compliance, tax, and pay-processing requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable product experiences for employers and their employees.

The ideal candidate combines deep payroll domain knowledge with strong product thinking and the ability to work across engineering, design, operations, and compliance teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end across the product development lifecycle.

### Key Responsibilities

* Own the product roadmap for the payroll domain - from discovery through delivery and adoption - aligning with business strategy and customer needs.
* Translate payroll, tax, and compliance requirements into clear, prioritized product requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Partner with engineering and design as a single-threaded owner to scope, sequence, and ship features with quality and on time.
* Drive payroll accuracy, run-cycle reliability, and exception/error handling as first-class product concerns.
* Use data and product analytics (especially Pendo) to measure adoption, identify friction, and inform prioritization.
* Manage the run-the-business (RTB) backlog alongside roadmap initiatives, balancing defect resolution with strategic investment.
* Engage stakeholders across operations, customer success, compliance, and leadership; communicate trade-offs in clear, decision-ready language.
* Stay current on payroll regulations, multi-jurisdiction tax handling, and competitive/industry trends to inform product direction.

### Required Qualifications

* 7-10 years of total experience with 4+ years in product management, ideally for B2B SaaS or HR/fintech platforms.
* Demonstrable payroll domain depth - pay calculation, tax withholding, deductions, garnishments, off-cycle/on-cycle runs, and compliance.
* Experience building or managing products in HCM, HRIS, payroll, benefits, or PEO/ASO environments.
* Strong product thinking: problem framing, prioritization, and the ability to balance customer, business, and technical constraints.
* Proven ability to write crisp PRDs/user stories and partner effectively with engineering and design.
* Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfort with product analytics and data-informed decision-making.
* Bachelors degree; equivalent practical experience considered.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with US payroll and multi-state tax compliance, or comparable regulated payroll markets.
* Exposure to PEO (Professional Employer Organization) or ASO (Administrative Services Organization) models.
* Familiarity with payroll integrations - GL, time attendance, benefits, and tax-filing partners.
* Experience with analytics tools such as Pendo, and discovery practices for B2B products.
* Prior work on platforms serving small and mid-sized businesses (SMB) at scale.

### Core Competencies

* Domain credibility - can hold their own with payroll operations and compliance experts.
* Ownership - drives outcomes end-to-end rather than executing tickets in isolation.
* Clarity - frames decisions, trade-offs, and edge cases in PM-ready, stakeholder-friendly language.
* Customer obsession - anchors prioritization in real user problems and measurable impact.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

You will serve as the product owner for the customer engagement: accountable for the problem being solved, the scope and success criteria, the deployment roadmap, and the business value ultimately delivered. You will also help identify which customer needs represent repeatable product opportunities and work with the internal teams to incorporate those insights into the broader product roadmap.

Beyond delivering individual customer engagements, you will help define the product, operating model, playbooks, and decision frameworks required to scale this new product and motion.

### Job Summary

**Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query**

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management

About the Role: Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it - how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level - write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.

You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line - see Who This Role Is Open To below.

### What You Will Own

* Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase - SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.
* Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use - hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.
* Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.
* Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.
* Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs - not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.
* Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.
* Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.
* Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.
* Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query - positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.
* External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.
* AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work - research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, benchmark analysis, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team s AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.
* Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

### What You Will Deliver

* PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.
* Shipped capabilities across query, indexing and search with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.
* A published, reproducible performance and cost position for your area that sales and engineering both stand behind.
* Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.
* Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses - measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.
* Contributions to the broader platform narrative - customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.
* Visible AI-driven PM practice - concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

### Must Have

* Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform - database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.
* Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, me…

* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

---------------

Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.  
  
This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.

About the team  
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.  
  
We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on Software Architect with deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and React to spearhead the modernization of legacy monolithic enterprise applications into resilient, scalable microservices architectures. This role sits at the intersection of engineering excellence and AI-led innovation — the ideal candidate will embed AI tooling across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from AI-assisted design and code generation through to automated testing and deployment. You will lead a small, high-performing team and work closely with business stakeholders to deliver modern, production-grade enterprise software.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the end-to-end modernization of monolithic enterprise applications into microservices, applying domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven architecture, and API-first principles.
* Architect and build scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot (Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data), and deliver modern, responsive frontend interfaces with React.
* Champion AI-led SDLC practices across the team — integrating AI-assisted coding (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent), automated code review, AI-generated test suites, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines.
* Lead and mentor a small team of engineers (3–6), conducting code reviews, setting technical standards, and driving a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Define and execute the migration strategy from monolith to microservices, including service decomposition, strangler-fig pattern adoption, and data decoupling.
* Design and implement RESTful and event-driven APIs, ensuring clean contracts, versioning, and robust integration with enterprise systems.
* Embed AI-driven automation across development workflows — automated test generation, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and intelligent alerting.
* Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions with clear delivery milestones.
* Ensure engineering best practices: SOLID principles, clean architecture, TDD, contract testing, observability, and security-by-design.
* Drive adoption of DevOps/DevSecOps practices including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and cloud-native deployment on AWS/GCP/Azure.

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12–15 years of progressive software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a software architect, principal, or senior lead role.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade modernization projects — ideally involving monolith-to-microservices migration at scale.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in agile delivery environments.
* Java & Spring Boot: Deep hands-on expertise in Java (17+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Gateway, Config, Eureka), Spring Security (OAuth2/JWT), and Spring Data JPA/Hibernate.
* Frontend – React: Proficient in React (Hooks, Context API, Redux), TypeScript, and building responsive, accessible enterprise UIs.
* Microservices & Architecture: Strong command of microservices patterns — service decomposition, API gateway, CQRS, event sourcing, saga pattern, and distributed tracing.
* AI-Led SDLC & Development: Practical experience embedding AI tools into the development lifecycle — AI-assisted coding, AI-driven code review, automated test generation (unit, integration, contract), and intelligent deployment pipelines.
* AI Integration: Ability to integrate LLM-based capabilities and AI services into enterprise applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, and API-based AI service consumption.
* Data & Messaging: Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle), NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on with AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Testing & Quality: Strong grounding in TDD, BDD, JUnit, Mockito, contract testing (Pact), and code quality tooling (SonarQube, Checkstyle).

**LEADERSHIP & WAYS OF WORKING**

* Proven ability to lead and mentor small engineering teams (3–6 engineers), driving technical growth and delivery quality.
* Strong engineering ownership mindset — takes accountability for design decisions, delivery timelines, and code quality across the team.
* Bias for action and pragmatic decision-making — able to balance technical rigour with the need for fast, iterative delivery.
* Collaborative stakeholder engagement — able to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Commitment to continuous learning, staying current with AI tooling, modern Java ecosystem developments, and cloud-native best practices.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience with AI automation frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and integrating agentic workflows into enterprise software.
* Familiarity with legacy modernisation tools and platforms (e.g., AWS Migration Hub, Replit, or similar).
* Experience in commercial real estate, financial services, or property-adjacent enterprise domains.
* Certifications in AWS/GCP/Azure architecture or Kubernetes.
* Prior exposure to Palantir, Salesforce, or ServiceNow integration patterns.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in diagnosing and resolving architectural debt and legacy system constraints.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.
* Collaborative mindset with a focus on knowledge sharing, documentation, and building team capability.
