jobs.title: Staff Inbound Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
  
  
Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
  
  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
* You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
* You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.

You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.
  
  
**What You Get To Do**
**Shape the solution**

* Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out-of-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
* Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution

**Deliver it with engineering**

* Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
* Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
* Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
* Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
* Own UAT coordination, go-live readiness, and hypercare
* Advise on platform best practices, upgrade-safe design, and technical debt avoidance

**Measure it**

* Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go-live
* Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
* Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment

**Accelerate it**

* Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise

**Influence the product**

* Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
* Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
* Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years delivering ServiceNow solutions, with at least 3 full lifecycle ITSM and ITOM deployments owned end to end
* Prior product management experience, formal or informal
* Experience operating in an internal IT / Customer Zero model, deploying capability before general availability
* Exposure to enterprise CMDB remediation at scale
* Experience with AI-driven service operations — AI Agents, Now A…

**Sourcing & Procurement product area**

You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions

* Stay fluent in the market realities shaping procurement products: data privacy, ERP/CRM ecosystems, connector marketplaces, and SaaS vs. on-prem considerations

**Work Across the Network & Lead the Team**

* Mentor and develop the Consultants and Analysts on your team, raising the bar on product craft, and act as the go-to escalation point for your product area
* Collaborate with Sourcing & Procurement SMEs to collect product feedback and establish an advisory council

**Key Deliverables**

* Owned roadmap and delivery for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, with direct input into broader portfolio strategy
* PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across all agent capabilities in your area
* Use-case catalog and prioritization framework (value, feasibility, risk, readiness)
* MVP/pilot plans with success metrics, rollout phases, and scale criteria
* Trust & governance artifacts: evaluation approach, monitoring plan, audit/logging requirements
* Release plans and launch-readiness inputs (docs, training, demo scripts, enablement)
* Customer feedback loop: telemetry dashboards, voice-of-customer insights, iteration plan
* Development plans and coaching cadence for direct reports/mentees

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality & reliability: task success rate, low rework/rollback rates, latency/uptime, healthy incident trends

jobs.description:
**About Company:**

At Delaplex, we believe true organizational distinction comes from exceptional products and services. Founded in 2008 by a team of like-minded business enthusiasts, we have grown into a trusted name in technology consulting and supply chain solutions. Our reputation is built on trust, innovation, and the dedication of our people who go the extra mile for our clients. Guided by our core values, we don t just deliver solutions, we create meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Process Decision Modeling**

* Design, author, and maintain BPMN 2.0 process models and DMN decision tables that accurately represent warehouse/DC operations, supply chain, and logistics workflows

* Translate operational and business requirements gathered from warehouse and DC stakeholders into executable process orchestration and decision automation logic

* Partner with engineering to validate that process models and decision tables execute correctly within the workflow/BPM engine, and troubleshoot modeling issues that surface during implementation

* Maintain a library of reusable process patterns, decision table standards, and modeling conventions to ensure consistency across the platform. Create the standard, productized workflows used by project teams.

* Partner with project development teams to ensure correct use of standard workflows and oversee any project specific workflow customizations, as needed.

* Identify and document task automation opportunities, orchestration patterns, and decision points within existing and proposed workflow processes

**Backlog Delivery Management**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog for the workflow/automation platform, balancing new process automation features against platform stability and technical debt

* Utilize Jira Product Discovery (JPD) to create and link epics and stories accordingly, ensure JPD is maintained on a regular basis in order to track progress

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog with stories always groomed and ready for development

* When authoring stories and epics, explicitly document non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security, availability), edge cases, and process/decision model changes - ensuring these are traceable acceptance criteria, not tribal knowledge

* Own the quality and consistency of all technical artifacts produced by the team - including BPMN/DMN modeling standards, story templates, and Definition of Ready/Done criteria

**Sprint Ceremonies**

* Facilitate and actively participate in all Agile ceremonies: Daily Stand-Up (DSU), Backlog Grooming, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, and Retrospective

* Pre-groom backlog items prior to grooming sessions and ensure all sprint tickets meet the teams Definition of Ready before Sprint Planning

* Own release readiness decisions - serving as the final go/no-go authority before sprint closes and before releases are promoted to production. Verify all stories meet Definition of Done, process/decision model changes are validated, and regression risk is understood. Partner with QA and DevOps on release checklists

* Continuously seek ways to improve workflows to and from developers and stakeholders

**Dependency Stakeholder Management**

* Proactively identify and track all dependency types - primarily across internal teams and third-party vendors - mapping them in Jira with owners, risk levels, and resolution timelines. Escalate unresolved dependencies before they become sprint blockers

* Work closely with warehouse/DC operations stakeholders and end users to ensure delivered process and decision models match real-world operational expectations

* Create tickets and communicate requirements for both your team and dependent teams

* Schedule and lead monthly customer demos

**PI Planning Execution**

* Lead scope negotiation during PI Planning to align team capacity against committed PI objectives; ensure every accepted story traces back to a PI objective. Identify and register risks during PI Planning events and maintain a living risk log throughout the increment

* Ensure PI objectives are broken down into milestones and sprint objectives that keep the team aligned to plan

* Maintain Jira data hygiene throughout the PI - ensuring epics, stories, defects, and issues are tracked so nothing falls through the cracks

* Ensure proper upload and closure of Jira items at the beginning and end of each PI in coordination with the Scrum Master

* Transition JPD initiative statuses accurately and document reasoning for any changes

* Contribute product and domain expertise to BPM engine migration efforts or vendor evaluations

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner on BPM/workflow engine platforms (process modeling, orchestration, task/decision automation)

* Hands-on BPMN 2.0 process design and DMN decision table authoring/maintenance

* Domain experience in warehouse/DC operations, supply chain, or logistics software

* Proven ability to translate operational/business requirements into executable process and decision models

* Experience owning a product backlog for a workflow/automation platform (prioritization, grooming, stakeholder alignment)

**Nice to Have**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner on BPM/workflow engine platforms (process modeling, orchestration, task/decision automation)

* Camunda 7 or 8 experience (modeler, engine, DMN tables, migration awareness a plus)

**Function:**

**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Client Solution Analyst – Engineering & BI**
to work at the intersection of
**clients, Business Operations, and Engineering teams**
.
  
  
This role will focus on understanding business and client requirements, translating them into clear and actionable requirements for Engineering and BI teams, coordinating solution delivery, analyzing business data, and ensuring effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate does not need to be a developer but should have a
**good understanding of technology and engineering environments**
, with the ability to understand technical concepts, communicate business requirements effectively, and collaborate closely with Engineering and BI teams.
  
  
**Key ResponsibilitiesClient & Business Requirement Management**

* Work closely with clients and Business Operations teams to understand business needs, challenges, workflows, and enhancement requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into clear, structured requirements that Engineering and BI teams can understand and execute.
* Conduct requirement discussions to clarify business logic, expected outcomes, priorities, and dependencies.
* Act as a key point of coordination for client and business requirements through the solution lifecycle.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide updates on requirements and solution progress.

***Engineering & BI Coordination***

* Act as a bridge between clients, Business Operations, Engineering, and BI teams.
* Work closely with engineers and BI teams to communicate business requirements and clarify functional expectations.
* Facilitate discussions between technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment.
* Coordinate solution requirements, priorities, dependencies, and changes with relevant teams.
* Track requirements and ensure appropriate follow-up through implementation.
* Help Business Operations understand technical considerations, limitations, and solution approaches communicated by Engineering teams.

***Business Intelligence & Data Analysis***

* Work with BI and Business Operations teams to understand reporting and data requirements.
* Analyze business and client data to identify trends, gaps, exceptions, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support requirements for reports, dashboards, metrics, and other BI solutions.
* Understand business metrics and help ensure reporting requirements accurately reflect operational needs.
* Translate business questions into structured data and reporting requirements.
* Provide insights that support operational and client-related decision-making.

***Solution & Implementation Coordination***

* Understand client and operational challenges and work with Engineering and BI teams to identify appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate requirements from initial discussion through development and implementation.
* Monitor progress and facilitate communication between stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Support the rollout and adoption of new solutions, enhancements, reports, and process changes.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with the original business objectives and client requirements.

***Requirement Documentation***

* Prepare and maintain clear documentation of business requirements, functional requirements, workflows, specifications, and change requests.
* Draft and finalize specifications with approval from the relevant User Department HOD or Business Owner before development begins.
* Maintain documentation of client requirements, approvals, decisions, changes, and implementation updates.
* Ensure requirements are clearly communicated and traceable across Business Operations, Engineering, and BI teams.

***Process Improvement & Automation***

* Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows and client-facing processes.
* Work with Business Operations and Engineering teams to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.
* Analyze recurring business or client challenges and support the development of scalable solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across business processes, reporting, and service delivery.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in Client Solutions, Business Analysis, Business Operations, BI, Product Operations, Engineering Operations, or a related role.
* Strong requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation skills.
* Experience working with Engineering/Technology teams and Business Operations stakeholders.
* Good understanding of technology and the ability to understand technical discussions without necessarily having hands-on development experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of business data, reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into requirements that technical teams can understand and technical information into language that business stakeholders can understand.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About NxtJob**

NxtJob.ai is an AI-first career platform for mid-to-senior Indian professionals. We run two programs. **Job Force One** is AI-assisted, coach-led job search. **Sw!tch** is our executive program for leaders making high-stakes career moves. Our nine AI agents cover the whole search, from choosing a niche and building a rsum to networking, interviews and negotiation. We're growing fast, and our data needs to keep up.

  

**The role**

You'll be our **first analyst**, working directly with the CXOs. You'll build the analytics layer across two areas. **Growth** covers every step from ad click to closed sale. **Operations** covers every step from onboarding to the client's offer letter. There's no team or playbook yet. Your job is to set up the structure, automate the reporting and find the insights the company runs on. Where AI can do the work, use it.

  

**What you'll own**

**Growth analytics (marketing CRM revenue)**

* End-to-end funnel reporting across our three entry points (VSL, evergreen webinar, paid bootcamp), then presales (bookers setters), sales calls and conversion to Job Force One and Sw!tch
* Attribution: clean UTM taxonomy, channel/campaign/creative-level CAC and ROAS across Meta and Google, reconciled against actual payments (not only what the ad platforms report)
* Lead-quality scoring and cohort analysis: which audiences, campaigns and webinars produce buyers, not just leads
* Revenue integrity: booking vs cash collected, deposit full-payment/EMI conversion, payment-failure diagnosis on high-ticket plans
* Presales and sales performance: dials, bookings, show rates, one-call closes vs follow-ups, objection trends, rep capacity
* Weekly business review and a KPI scorecard for every function, all tied to one north-star metric

  

**Operations analytics (client delivery)**

* Client-lifecycle funnel, covering onboarding rsum LinkedIn activation retention, with stage-to-stage time gaps, SLA breaches and where clients get stuck
* Active-job-search outcomes: outreach volume, acceptance, referrals, screenings, interviews and offers, tracked per client, per account manager and per cohort
* AM performance dashboards, early at-risk signals, and data to support escalations
* Sw!tch program analytics: pipeline setup in our ERP, phase progression, coach/panel utilisation and outcome tracking for leadership clients
* Community and engagement metrics, and how engagement relates to job outcomes

  

**Data infrastructure & automation**

* Own the pipelines connecting ads platforms, website/app events, CRM/ERP, payment gateway and the product database into one reliable source of truth
* Fix data quality at the source (broken exports, macro-less UTMs, inconsistent definitions) and document every metric definition
* Replace manual spreadsheets with automated dashboards, alerts and scheduled reports
* Build AI into the workflow: LLM-assisted analysis, auto-generated insight summaries, anomaly detection and natural-language querying for non-technical teams
* Teach data literacy: run funnel and reporting sessions so every team reads its own numbers

  

**You'll likely have**

* 25 years in business/growth/ops analytics, ideally at a D2C, edtech, SaaS or other high-velocity startup
* Strong SQL (MySQL); comfortable pulling from production and CRM databases on your own
* Advanced Sheets/Excel plus one BI tool (Looker Studio, Metabase, Power BI, Tableau)
* Working knowledge of Meta/Google Ads data, UTM/attribution and CRM funnels
* Python or Apps Script for automation, and a habit of using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) to work 3 faster
* Structured thinking: you can turn a vague CXO question into a metric, a query and a recommendation in the same day
* Clear communication: one sharp insight beats a 40-tab dashboard

### Job Summary

Job Title: Business Analyst - Pharma / Life Sciences. Location: Bangalore, India. Experience: 6-10 years. Type: Full-time. About the Role: We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences domain experience to join our enterprise transformation practice. You will sit between business stakeholders and delivery teams on large SAP and digital programs - translating regulated, process-heavy business needs into clear, buildable requirements, and making sure what ships actually solves the problem.

### Key Responsibilities

* Elicit, analyse and document business requirements through workshops, stakeholder interviews and process walkthroughs with Pharma business users (Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Commercial).
* Produce high-quality artefacts: BRDs, functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, process flows (As-Is / To-Be), traceability matrices and data mapping documents.
* Perform fit-gap analysis against standard SAP functionality and recommend standard-first solutions, flagging genuine gaps for custom build.
* Partner with functional and technical consultants to shape solution design, and review build against agreed requirements.
* Drive UAT - define test scenarios, coordinate business testers, triage defects, and manage sign-off.
* Support validation and compliance deliverables where the solution falls under GxP / regulated scope (URS, traceability, change control documentation).
* Manage scope and change: assess change requests for impact on cost, timeline and risk, and support the CAB / governance process.
* Support data migration and cutover activities from a requirements and business-readiness perspective.
* Contribute to training material, SOP updates and hypercare support post go-live.

### Domain Experience Required

* Demonstrable experience on projects in at least two of the following Pharma value-chain areas: Manufacturing Batch Management (batch genealogy, yield, shop-floor integration)
* Quality Management (inspection plans, deviations, CAPA, batch release)
* Supply Chain Serialisation (track trace, DSCSA / EU FMD, cold chain, lot traceability)
* Regulatory Master Data (material/recipe master, specification management, product registration)
* Commercial / Distribution (chargebacks, rebates, contracts, tender pricing)

### Must-Have Skills

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years on Pharma or Life Sciences programs.
* Hands-on experience with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA in relevant modules (MM, PP-PI, QM, SD, EWM).
* Strong requirements engineering skills - able to write specs a developer can build from without re-interviewing the business.
* Working knowledge of regulated-environment concepts: GxP, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity (ALCOA+), computer system validation.
* Comfortable in both Agile (user stories, backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies) and Waterfall delivery models.
* Proficiency with JIRA / Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or Signavio, and Excel-based analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; confident facilitating workshops with senior client stakeholders.

### Good to Have

* Exposure to SAP BTP, Fiori/UI5, or integration platforms (CPI/Integration Suite).

* Prior consulting or system-integrator background with client-facing delivery exposure.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Requirements Analysis & Discovery: Drive functional discovery sessions with business stakeholders and customers to capture, analyze, and translate complex core P&C insurance requirements into detailed functional specifications, user stories, and process flowcharts.
* Stakeholder & Functional Leadership: Lead functional discussions, design walkthroughs, and alignment workshops with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and client teams.
* Solution Architecture & POC Demos: Package innovative solutions and lead interactive Proof-of-Concept (POC) demonstrations to prospective and existing clients to showcase platform capabilities and product fit.
* Engineering & Product Collaboration: Act as the primary domain Subject Matter Expert (SME) for engineering development teams, clarifying functional edge-cases, business rules, and workflow logic throughout the SDLC.
* Quality & Acceptance Sign-off: Define functional acceptance criteria and perform functional UAT/validation to formally sign off on application quality and compliance before client releases.
* System Integration Understanding: Analyze how core P&C platforms integrate with upstream/downstream systems (e.g., rating engines, payment gateways, third-party data providers, document generation, and reporting tools).

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 3 to 5 years of hands-on functional experience in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain (Policy, Claims, or Billing).
* Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of core P&C lines of business (Commercial/Personal lines like Auto, Property, General Liability, Workers' Comp), product lifecycle processes (quoting, underwriting, binding, endorsements, claims handling), and system workflows.
* Requirements Management: Proven track record in requirement elicitation, wireframing, user story writing, mapping business rules, and gap analysis.
* Solution & Demo Skills: Practical experience assembling solution components and delivering engaging POC demos to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Quality Sign-off: Hands-on capability to validate functional user flows, lead end-to-end user acceptance testing (UAT), and provide official sign-offs for production releases.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with an ability to articulate functional solutions clearly to customer leadership and internal engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with standard core insurance platforms (e.g., Guidewire PolicyCenter/ClaimCenter, Duck Creek, Majesco, or custom cloud-native P&C SaaS applications).
* Exposure to North American (US/Canada) or UK/European P&C insurance markets and regulatory frameworks.
* Relevant industry certifications such as AIC, AINS, CPCU, or FLMI are a strong plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentive structure.
* Flexible/hybrid work arrangements.
* Continuous professional development and sponsorship for global P&C domain certifications.
* Opportunity to work with modern enterprise AI, digital transformation tools, and global enterprise clients.

jobs.title: Sr Operations Analyst, Services
jobs.description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Title** : Sr Operations Analyst

**Reporting to:** Director, GTM Operations

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Sales Operations

  
  

**Overview**

Quickbase is seeking a Senior Analyst, Services Operations to serve as the lead operations partner for our Professional Services organization. Your primary charter is to make services delivery repeatable and predictable, its impact on customer outcomes measurable, and its capacity planning.

You will partner with the Services leadership team to define the frameworks, metrics, and models that we use to run the business. Your work will directly shape how we measure customer time to value, how we decide where to invest in services, and how our customer success teams recommend services to customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Partnership with Services Leadership**

Your primary relationship is with the Services senior leadership team. You are their operations partner for planning, measurement, and decision support — bringing structure and evidence to capacity decisions, investment cases, delivery performance reviews, and the operating cadence that runs the business. When Services leadership needs to know how the organization is performing or what to do next, you are the first call.

From there, you extend that support into the delivery organization, tailoring what you build to how each role works, including Project Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Consultants, and Technical Account Managers.

**Systems & Requirements Ownership**

* Partner with the development team behind our professional services automation (PSA) platform to understand the product roadmap and translate it into downstream operational impact, including effects on customer success systems and workflows

* Own requirements gathering and definition with Services leadership, and carry those requirements proactively to our data and analytics team for implementation in our data warehouse and BI layer

**Customer Outcome & Services Effectiveness Analytics**

* Build the analytical framework for time to value on services engagements — definition, instrumentation, and segmentation by package, customer segment, and engagement type

* Assess the effectiveness of prior services investment through a customer outcome lens: adoption depth, retention and expansion, and support load reduction for serviced vs. non-serviced accounts

* Define the customer-success-facing services metric set — the signals that tell a Customer Success Manager when to recommend a services engagement, which package fits a given account, where in the customer lifecycle it lands best, and what outcome to hold the engagement to afterward

* Identify repeatable delivery practices that accelerate customer value realization, and convert those findings into operational changes — playbook triggers, customer success plays, and scoping guidance

**Forecasting & Capacity Planning**

* Build services forecasting frameworks by package, with a clear structural distinction between revenue-generating services and services delivered as investment — these behave differently and should never be reported as one number

* Partner with FP&A to feed operational forecasts into capacity modeling and investment and hiring decisions, owning forecast volume, package mix, delivery capacity, and demand signal

**Automation, AI & Enablement**

* Identify, scope, and shepherd AI and automation use cases for Services — project status summarization, engagement artifact generation, and automated project health flagging — to give time back to the delivery team

* Partner with Enablement to define standard operating procedures that set clear expectations for team members, ensuring each procedure maps to an actual step in our systems rather than living only in a document

**New Offering Readiness**

* Own operational readiness for new services offerings and packages coming to market, including entitlement reporting impact, services intake changes, KPI and reporting implications, and pre-launch readiness review

**Required Experience**

* 4–6 years in Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or Services Operations, including direct experience supporting a professional services, consulting, or delivery organization

* Working knowledge of professional services operating mechanics — utilization, bookings-to-delivery, backlog, resource capacity, and scoping accuracy — and the practical difference between revenue-generating services and investment services

* Experience with professional services automation (PSA) tooling and how it integrates with CRM and customer success platforms

* Experience building forecasting or capacity models and partnering with Finance on how those models are used

* Demonstrated analytical rigor on outcome questions — able to structure a defensible comparison, such as serviced vs. non-serviced customer cohorts, and defend it to an executive audience

Comfortable specifying requirements against a data warehouse and BI environment (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI) without owning the build

jobs.title: Product Manager II, Google Workspace
jobs.description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience driving product direction, go-to-market strategy, and design with data-driven decisions.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in a technology or business related field.
* Experience launching successful app products in the market.
* Experience with complex product/outbound customer work, and developing products with an understanding of current cloud technologies and services.
* Knowledge of market, landscape, and customer/user requirements in-depth.
* Ability to collaborate, solve ambiguous problems, and think innovatively.
* Excellent communication, technical, and organizational skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The mission of the Google Workspace team is to deliver flexible, innovative solutions for people and organizations to achieve more. As a Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and set product priorities. You will partner closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to define and deliver on cloud services.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the product direction and strategy for product areas within Google Workspace.
* Design and lead the product roadmap by managing goals and investments to scale globally.
* Engage with customers to understand their strategies, end-to-end business processes, pain points, and priorities to inform product strategy and provide transparency into roadmaps/managing expectations.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX, and other internal Google teams to drive product and delivery success. Analyze landscape and industry trends to advance our products and drive innovation.
* Foster and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders, delivery partners, and operational teams. Attract, develop, and retain an excellent team of product managers.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Product Line Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**
----------------------------------

The Product Specialist serves as the operational backbone of the Process Performance Motor portfolio, responsible for maintaining product data quality, supporting lifecycle projects, coordinating cross-functional activities, and providing market and competitive intelligence. This role translates customer and market needs into actionable insights, ensuring that Product Management and R&D decisions are grounded in accurate data and real customer requirements.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ; #LI-Hybrid

The role is contributing to the Motion / IEC Low Voltage Motors division globally.

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Market Intelligence & Customer Insight: Gathering market data and customer feedback from sales to identify trends, unmet needs, and market requirements that guide portfolio decisions.
* Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking: Analyzing competitor portfolios, benchmarking technical performance and identifying portfolio gaps to maintain competitive advantage.
* R&D and Product Management Support: Bridging market needs and product development by supporting business cases, consolidating requirements, managing initiatives and tracking project execution from development through launch.
* Product Data & Portfolio Excellence: Ensuring product information accuracy and completeness throughout the lifecycle by identifying data gaps, driving corrections, and supporting sales with product-related questions.

**Qualifications for the role**
-------------------------------

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Sales or Marketing
* Good knowledge of low voltage motors, low voltage motors markets, customer needs and portfolio
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration or related fields
* Strong drive and commitment/ passion to shape and develop the business
* Ability to develop strong international network within the organization and collaborate with key stakeholders to achieve business results
* Analytical thinking (ability to lead market and portfolio analysis, draw conclusions and identify and prioritize strategic options)
* Can-do attitude, eager to learn new things and grow professionally.
* Proactive and structured work-style
* Fluent written and spoken communication skills in English

**More about us**
-----------------

The IEC Low Voltage Division is a technology leader delivering a full range of energy-efficient low voltage motors, including ultra-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Through a global footprint, domain expertise and rugged designs, the Division provides reliable technology that improves efficiency and productivity even in the most demanding applications.

**We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website** **www.abb.com****.**

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Lead UA Manager
jobs.description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break.

We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters.

This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio, so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, with onsite work 5 days per week, where daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Steer portfolio UA.** Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest.
* **Grow a brilliant team.** Lead and coach our UA Managers, give each of them clear ownership of their games, and help them do the best work of their careers.
* **Unlock profitable scale.** Find the games ready to grow faster, and move quickly when something isn’t paying back.
* **Keep targets sharp.** Work with our analytics team on LTV and ROAS targets, and bring a healthy challenge when the numbers don’t add up.
* **Power the creative engine.** Partner with our creative and analytics teams so every game has a steady flow of fresh ads being tested, learned from, and scaled.
* **Give new games a fair shot.** Run clean, consistent market tests for our new game ideas so we can spot the winners early.
* **Be the UA voice in our game teams.** Share what the market is telling us with producers, product, and monetisation, and turn game improvements into more growth.
* **Build great partnerships.** Work closely with ad networks and platforms, and keep exploring new channels

### **What You’ll Own:**

**Profitable growth across our portfolio.** You’ll be the go-to owner of how our games grow: spotting opportunities first, catching dips early, keeping targets sharp, and helping your team stay on top of every game they own.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Profitable spend and installs at or above target payback
* ROAS and payback against target
* UA contribution to profit across the portfolio
* How quickly budget moves to the best opportunities
* A happy, growing UA team

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior UA experience in mobile games, with F2P titles you’ve scaled profitably across ad networks and social channels.
* Experience leading or mentoring UA Managers.
* A strong grasp of ROAS, payback, LTV and cohort analysis, and of measurement in today’s privacy- first world.
* A love of creative testing, and a feel for what makes an ad win on different channels.
* Great commercial judgement: you can explain every budget decision in pounds.
* Happy to get hands-on with campaigns, spreadsheets, and BI tools.
* A clear, confident communicator who brings people along with evidence.

**Desirable**

* Hybrid-casual or puzzle mobile game experience is a big plus.

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.

We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone…

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Creative Industrial Automation is a UAE-based distributor and manufacturer of industrial automation products, including pneumatics, hydraulics, sensors, and electrical control components.

We have our head office in Dubai, showrooms in Ajman and Abu Dhabi, a branch in Saudi Arabia, and e-commerce operations serving the UAE and GCC markets.

jobs.description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

jobs.description:
**About Yulu**

Yulu is India’s leading shared micro-mobility platform, revolutionizing urban transportation through smart, sustainable, and electric-first mobility solutions. With a rapidly growing fleet of tech-enabled electric two-wheelers and a robust battery-swapping infrastructure, Yulu makes last-mile commutes not only efficient but also planet-friendly.

Our IoT-driven platform and smart electric vehicles are helping cities reduce traffic congestion and carbon emissions while empowering millions with affordable and reliable transportation.

Backed by industry giants like Bajaj Auto and Magna International, Yulu operates at the intersection of mobility, technology, and sustainability. Our mission is to reduce congestion, cut emissions, and transform how India moves — one ride at a time.

With millions of rides completed, thousands of EVs on the road, and a rapidly expanding footprint, we’re not just building EVs — we’re building the future of urban mobility in India.

🔗 Learn more: www.yulu.bike

**Role Summary**

As a Product Manager at Yulu, you will own the product experience for gig workers who rely on Yulu for their daily mobility, from the rental journey to battery swaps. Your goal is to make every ride seamless, reliable, and cost-efficient so gig workers can maximize their earnings. Working with engineering, data science, business, and operations, you will use user insights, real-time analytics, and AI-driven optimization to improve gig worker satisfaction and retention.

If you thrive on solving real-world user pain points, improving financial outcomes for gig workers, and building scalable mobility solutions, join us in shaping the future of electric last-mile mobility!

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the gig worker journey end-to-end, from rental to battery swaps, removing friction at every step.
* Define the product vision and strategy for the gig worker experience, grounded in user insights and business goals.
* Build and prioritize the roadmap around measurable outcomes: gig worker earnings, satisfaction, and retention.
* Drive products from ideation to launch and scale, iterating continuously on what the data and the field show.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Own Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), integrating insights from engineering, business, and customer support, and socialize them to align teams on scope and expectations.
* Work with founders and cross-functional teams in a matrix setup, balancing stakeholder needs to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Act as a product advocate, articulating product value and upcoming enhancements, and run demos to drive adoption and gather feedback.
* Proactively address roadmap bottlenecks, working with the team to ensure seamless execution and the achievement of product goals.

**Innovation & Growth**

* Identify and drive new product ideas and enhancements from user and stakeholder insights.
* Scale the gig worker experience as Yulu expands into new cities and markets.

**Metrics & Insights**

* Set OKRs and success metrics for the gig worker experience, and review them regularly with the team.
* Measure the impact of every launch, using experiments and funnel analysis across the rental and battery swap journeys to decide what to build next.
* Spend regular time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, combining what you see with support and usage data to find the biggest pain points.
* Flag risks early and drive solutions to complex problems.

**Key Requirements**

* B.Tech / MBA or equivalent practical experience in product management.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of delivering impactful products.
* Experience building consumer-facing mobile products used daily at scale, ideally in mobility, logistics, quick-commerce, or on-demand delivery.
* Ability to define, track, and drive product outcomes through clear metrics, OKRs, and data-led decisions.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in daily product workflows, from input collection and research to documentation and prototyping.
* A habit of spending time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, turning direct user insights into product decisions.
* Deep ownership and a strong sense of urgency, with the ability to drive initiatives from ideation to execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative and open culture where your ideas and opinions are valued.
* Challenging and rewarding problem statements that deepen your understanding of Product Management.
* A dynamic and growth-driven journey that pushes you to learn, innovate, and excel.

jobs.title: AI Security & Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Metaforms**
-------------------

Metaforms builds AI infrastructure for research delivery teams. Our agents help market research agencies and sample providers execute complex workflows with greater speed, consistency, and scale.

As these agents interact with customer data, files, APIs, integrations, and other tools, security must be built into every layer of the platform. We are looking for an engineer who is excited about understanding how AI systems can fail—and building the controls that make them safe, reliable, and secure by default.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for an **AI Security & Platform Engineer** to help secure the AI agents and infrastructure behind Metaforms.

You will test our AI systems adversarially, identify vulnerabilities across prompts, context, data, tools, integrations, and execution environments, and work with engineers to fix them properly. You will also build platform-level controls, automated evaluations, monitoring, and secure infrastructure that prevent similar vulnerabilities from recurring.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a policy or compliance position. You will write code, inspect production systems, reproduce vulnerabilities, build security tooling, and contribute directly to product and infrastructure improvements.

You will work closely with engineering leadership and gradually take ownership of larger AI security and platform initiatives.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

### **AI and agent security**

* Adversarially test AI agents for prompt injection, context poisoning, unsafe tool use, data leakage, memory manipulation, and unintended behavior.
* Identify security risks introduced through customer prompts, uploaded files, retrieved content, external links, integrations, and model-generated outputs.
* Test whether agents can access unauthorized tools, records, tenants, credentials, or internal services.
* Threat-model new AI features, agent workflows, model integrations, and tool-calling capabilities before they reach production.
* Evaluate risks in RAG pipelines, context assembly, agent memory, system prompts, MCP servers, model providers, and third-party AI frameworks.
* Build repeatable adversarial evaluations and regression tests for discovered vulnerabilities.
* Design controls for least-privilege tool access, scoped credentials, sandboxing, runtime policy enforcement, and human approval.
* Ensure model output is validated before it reaches databases, APIs, executable systems, or customer-visible workflows.
* Improve auditability across model calls, retrieved context, tool invocations, agent decisions, and resulting actions.
* Monitor emerging AI attack techniques and translate relevant risks into practical product controls.

### **Product security**

* Review customer-facing applications and APIs for authentication, authorization, tenant-isolation, injection, and business-logic vulnerabilities.
* Secure customer-controlled payloads, file uploads, webhooks, exports, and third-party integrations.
* Reproduce security reports, determine credible impact, and distinguish exploitable vulnerabilities from theoretical findings.
* Work directly with engineers to implement production-ready fixes and regression tests.
* Help build secure, reusable patterns for input handling, authorization, secrets, data access, and external integrations.
* Perform focused code reviews, penetration tests, and architecture assessments for security-sensitive changes.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
* Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross-team and cross-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
* Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
* Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
* Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.
* Define and track the metrics that show whether governance is provable and whether automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to prioritize.
* Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

  
About the team  
The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices & Services (D&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- - Understanding of AI architecture and integration patterns

- - Ability to drive technical decisions across teams  
- - Advanced program management capabilities  
- - Experience defining technical metrics  
- - Track record of process optimization  
- - Experience with rapid technology adoption  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst (BSA) – Ironclad CLM
jobs.description:
The
**Business Systems Analyst (BSA) – Ironclad CLM**
will lead business process discovery and translate contracting needs into clear, scalable, and build-ready business requirements.

Working across
**Legal, Procurement, Commercial, Finance, Digital Solutions, and implementation partners**
, the BSA will facilitate process decisions, define future-state workflows and system handoffs, support contract migration planning and data requirements, and help establish sustainable governance and operating practices.

The BSA will primarily own
**business analysis, process design, requirements traceability, stakeholder alignment, testing, and user enablement**
, while partnering closely with platform administrators, architects, integration engineers, and technical resources responsible for configuration and implementation.

**Core Responsibilities**

1. Business Systems Analysis & Solution Design

**Requirements & Process Discovery**

* Lead cross-functional discovery workshops with Legal, Procurement, Commercial, Finance, and technical stakeholders.
* Document current-state processes, pain points, gaps, controls, dependencies, and business requirements.
* Define scalable future-state contracting processes and workflows.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and drive alignment on key process and solution decisions.

**Discovery & Design Artifacts**

* Lead the completion and quality review of Ironclad discovery workbooks and related design artifacts.
* Document and validate requirements related to:
* Workflow discovery
* Launch forms
* Contract properties and metadata
* Approval processes
* Signatures
* Permissions
* Repository requirements
* Workflow feedback and business rules

**Requirements & Design Documentation**

* Translate business needs into clear and actionable:
* Business requirements
* User stories
* Process maps
* Business rules
* Acceptance criteria
* Functional specifications
* Build-ready design artifacts
* Maintain end-to-end traceability of requirements, assumptions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and open questions throughout implementation.

**Workflow Solution Design**

* Define business requirements for:
* Contract templates
* Intake and launch forms
* Metadata and properties
* Approval routing
* Standard and fallback clauses
* Permissions
* Negotiation and review workflows
* Partner with the Ironclad Platform Administrator and implementation resources responsible for platform configuration and technical delivery.

**Integration Requirements & Process Handoffs**

* Define business requirements for integrations and system handoffs, including:
* Triggering events
* Source-of-record ownership
* Field mappings
* Approval dependencies
* Exception paths
* Reconciliation requirements
* Collaborate with architects, administrators, and integration engineers responsible for technical design and implementation.

**Testing & Release Management**

* Develop UAT scenarios, test scripts, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate testing activities with business stakeholders.
* Maintain requirements-to-test and defect traceability.
* Validate that configured solutions meet defined business requirements.
* Support release planning, production readiness, and go-live activities.

2. Ironclad Migration & Data Architecture Participation

**Data Architecture Contribution**

* Collaborate with technical leads, architects, and Legal Operations to define:
* Contract taxonomies
* Standardized metadata schemas
* Record types
* Parent-child agreement hierarchies
* Repository structures
* Help ensure that data structures support business processes, reporting, governance, and long-term scalability.

**Migration Execution Support**

* Participate in the end-to-end migration of legacy contracts from existing repositories into the Ironclad Repository.
* Support data mapping, staging, migration planning, and bulk ingestion activities.
* Work with technical teams to validate migration requirements and business rules.

**Smart Import & Data Validation**

* Support bulk legacy contract imports, including OCR and Ironclad Smart Import.
* Perform or coordinate data cleansing, deduplication, and quality-assurance activities.
* Conduct post-migration data validation and reconciliation to verify accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

3. Change Management, Enablement & Training

**Change Impact Execution**

* Develop and execute structured change-management activities to transition cross-functional teams from manual or legacy contracting practices to automated, self-service workflows.
* Assess process and role impacts and help stakeholders understand changes to their ways of working.

**Role-Based Training Delivery**

* Design and deliver live and on-demand training tailored to different user personas, including:
* **Sales / Requesters:**
  Intake and self-service contracting
* **Legal Counsel:**
  Contract review, negotiation, and redlining
* **Approvers:**
